=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3040-3052, `_inject_token_into_url` and lines 3074-3084, `_resolve_origin_url` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded into HTTPS clone URLs instead of being supplied through command-scoped `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, `/proc`, Git diagnostics, and logged remote URLs, regressing the credential-free URL contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-184, 578-588, 594-604, 624-630, 767-773, 883-889, 919-925 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `_memory_git` authentication wrapper was removed, leaving bare Git operations and token-bearing force-tick URLs.
  WHY: Memory operations either expose credentials through argv and `.git/config` or fail against the unauthenticated HTTPS origin with `persist-credentials: false`.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81, 88-118, 432-480 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication is configured only in a step-local environment while later memory operations use credential-free HTTPS origins.
  WHY: `GIT_CONFIG_*` does not persist to lineage finalization and memory helper steps, so `memory_ensure_branch` cannot authenticate.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path (lines 240-247), emit_context (lines 536-716), deleted `is_sensitive_target_path` and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count protections were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted issue and plan paths can read `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, and other credential files into model prompts, including through symlinks.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Marker-only entries and headers are appended without incrementing `used_bytes`, and the `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap was removed.
  WHY: A large untrusted path list can exceed the documented `max_bytes` prompt budget by an arbitrary amount.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 668-670 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase runs issue-derived prompt content with `--sandbox danger-full-access` without the model-provider broker while `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remain present.
  WHY: The model can read or exfiltrate credentials and mutate the workspace outside the previous brokered isolation boundary.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: entire file now ends at line 140; deleted `model_provider_broker_*` functions | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared model-provider broker lifecycle and execution APIs were deleted while existing workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Brokered model phases abort with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found`, disabling plan, implement, review, validate, security-audit, orchestration, triage, and related paths.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7, argument parser lines 49-64, `--process-group-file` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and process-group tracking were removed while `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553` still passes the option.
  WHY: The stall guard exits with an unknown-option error before launching the editor, matching the reported `AUTOFIX_EDITOR_EMPTY_NOOP` failures and removing isolation cleanup verification.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` and `review_blocked_*` helpers | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authenticated Git and review-blocked approval, successor, and terminal-flow helpers were removed while callers remain.
  WHY: `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` fail on missing functions or cannot complete authenticated pushes and approval flows.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 768-772 (REST transform), lines 833-847, 913-924 (GraphQL transform) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]

  WHY: Review-blocked producer and approver identity checks cannot authenticate comments; moonshotai_kimi-k3 reports that current approval paths retain identity fields through inline comment fetching, so this finding has reviewer disagreement.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 105-112, 147-150, 258-264, line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and the generated provider URL was hard-coded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Existing callers pass the broker URL and now exit with an unknown-argument error; bypassing that would defeat broker credential isolation.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30, 37, 714, 716, 776-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports and calls deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError` before any targeted-file-context test executes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 101-237, staged-support restore block | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Staged-support restoration is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow creates or exports them.
  WHY: The protection is dead, allowing self-repository implement runs to overwrite branch-owned helper changes with support-ref copies.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 200-205 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` argument order is reported as using the wrong common-ancestor/other-side order.
  WHY: Reviewers report that it can silently drop branch changes; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly rejects this finding and states the documented `<current-file> <base-file> <other-file>` order is correct.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 4-69, SSB_REASON branch | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support failure handler expects `SSB_REASON` and `SSB_FILES`, but no caller exports them.
  WHY: Staged-support conflicts do not reach the intended `ai:needs-human` handling and can repeat through generic recovery.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 59-68 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `pre_assembled_static.txt` preservation changed from checking committed `HEAD` content to checking only index membership, while the `git rm --cached` path was removed.
  WHY: A staged worktree file can be removed without being unstaged and appear as an editor-authored deletion.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: run_without_guard at lines 11-22 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The Python-unavailable fallback no longer records `state=unguarded` or refuses isolated launches.
  WHY: Watchdog and cleanup consumers cannot distinguish an unsupervised editor from a guarded one.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_file_lock` former lines 3038-3055 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Public function `_file_lock` was removed without an alias.
  WHY: Tests and downstream callers can fail with `ImportError`.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_resolve_origin_url` lines 3074-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_resolve_origin_url` changed from returning a credential-free URL to returning a token-bearing URL.
  WHY: Existing callers expecting credential-free origins now receive a credential-leaking URL.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 140, 150-151, 180, 597-602, 767, 884, 920 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The no-token path no longer preserves the previous distinction between unauthenticated fail-open behavior and authenticated memory operations.
  WHY: Operators lose signal that memory records are stale, while authenticated paths either embed a token or fail against the bare HTTPS origin.
